verdict.rationale: a-Shell works with Apple Shortcuts and gives them full control of the shell, so users can build multi-step automations that download, process and release files using a-Shell commands. The `.profile` hook adds startup scripting when a window opens. Nothing in the evidence shows these automations running unattended in the background, on a schedule, or on triggers, and there is no AI or agent-driven automation. Missing for 10: background or scheduled execution (e.g. cron or background tasks), autonomous trigger-based runs, AI/agent-driven automation, independent or hands-on corroboration.
